claims.text: Notices go to the parties at the addresses on the first page of the Agreement, unless a party has specified another address in writing.

citations.quote: Notice shall be sent to the parties          at the addresses set forth on the first page of this Agreement or at          such other address as shall be specified by either party to the          other in writing.

claims.text: The notice addresses are the ones set out at the beginning of the Agreement.

citations.quote: the addresses of the respective parties have been set out at the beginning of this Agreement

claims.text: A change of notice address is not binding on the other party until written notice of the change is received at the address shown in the Agreement.

citations.quote: no change of address shall be binding upon the other party hereto until written notice thereof is received by such party at the address shown herein.

claims.text: The excerpts provided do not include the actual addresses themselves, so the specific addresses cannot be identified from these sources.
